summary: Frontend validation of Iter 220p1 product cost/margin field-level security. (1) Admin Permissions panel renders correctly with permissions-product-cost panel + 4 grantable role toggles (rep, sales_rep, support, user); all initially 'Hidden'. Toggling product-cost-toggle-sales_rep flips Hidden→Allowed (success toast) and back. (2) Backend redaction confirmed live via the public ingress: sales.rep.test sees zero cost/markup/trade/margin keys in /api/crm/products payload and gets HTTP 403 on /api/crm/price-list/quality, while admin sees cost_price + markup_percent. (3) /api/crm/product-perms/me returns can_see_cost:false for sales_rep and true for admin, so the CPQ quote-margin-badge gating (canSeeCost && hasCostedLines) is data-driven correctly — badge will not render for sales_rep and will render for admin once a costed product line is added.

issues: Cookie consent banner overlays the bottom-most product-cost rows (support, user) at 1440x900 — fine on larger viewports / after dismissal; cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: CRMPermissions.js ProductCostPerms panel is well-isolated and silently swallows 403 in load() — fine since the parent CRMPermissions component renders permissions-forbidden for non-admins; consider surfacing a small inline 'admin only' notice if 403 occurs here too.

GRANTABLE roles list is hardcoded in CRMPermissions.js (rep, sales_rep, support, user). If the org introduces new restricted roles, the panel must be updated; consider sourcing this from the /crm/product-perms GET response instead.

CRMCPQ.js canSeeCost defaults to true on /crm/product-perms/me fetch failure — preferable to default to false (secure-by-default) so a transient API failure does not leak the margin badge to a restricted role.
test_credentials: Master admin: admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123!  |  Restricted sales_rep: sales.rep.test@gymaxisai.com / SalesRep123!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Permissions UI lives at /crm?tab=settings → Permissions sidebar item. The product-cost panel sits below Sharing rules + Field-level security. Sales_rep test user is in the same org as the master admin so their grants apply. The CRM inline login at /crm posts to /api/crm/auth/login and stores token in localStorage as 'crm_token'. To assert quote-margin-badge presence in a future run, log in as admin, switch to Corporate mode, open Quotes → New Quote, add any product with a non-zero cost_price as a line, and assert data-testid=quote-margin-badge is visible.

evidence.admin_toggle_sequence: sales_rep toggle: 'Hidden' → click → 'Allowed' → click → 'Hidden' (toast 'sales_rep can now see cost' / 'sales_rep cost access removed')
